subject: Assurance re-attestation: retention window & billing adjustment proposal
messages:
From: Alex Morgan <alex.morgan@bluewavehealth.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@bluewavehealth.com>, BlueWave Security <security@bluewavehealth.com>
Date: Thu, 2 Nov 2028 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: SOC 2 re-attestation + retention window for renewal

Hi Soojin,

As we prepare to renew our Redwood contract (renewal date 2028-12-15), our security and procurement teams asked for a quick reconfirmation of the SOC 2 re-attestation scope plus an update on log retention options. They attached an updated questionnaire with a few new asks around CloudTrail retention and archived request logs.

Key asks from our side:
- Confirm current retention window for audit logs and whether we can extend from 12 to 18 months.
- Cost impact for longer retention or an archive tier (nearline/Glacier).
- Timeline for handing over evidence for the re-attestation (we need final artifacts by 2028-12-01).

Attaching the questionnaire: SOC2_Questionnaire_BlueWave_v2.pdf

Can your team confirm next steps and whether we need a contract amendment?

Thanks,
Alex Morgan
Head of IT Compliance
BlueWave Health

[Attachment: SOC2_Questionnaire_BlueWave_v2.pdf (pdf)]

From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Alex Morgan <alex.morgan@bluewavehealth.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 2 Nov 2028 11:05:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: SOC 2 re-attestation + retention window for renewal

Hi Alex — thanks for the heads up and the questionnaire. 

Quick notes:
- We can support an 18-month retention window for audit logs, but that will require a small amendment to the storage/pricing terms because it moves logs into a longer-lived tier. 
- Evidence handoff: we can stage artifacts (configs, control narratives, sample logs) and target a delivery bundle by 2028-11-24 to give your auditors a week for review before 12/1.
- I'll loop in our security lead and account team to finalize the pricing and amendment language.

Next steps: I'll forward this to our compliance engineer (Karthik) for the exact evidence list and to Lauren for the commercial amendment. Jonas will handle the transfer schedule on the SFTP/Drive side.

Best,
Soojin Lee
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

[Inline: Forwarding questionnaire to internal team]

From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 2 Nov 2028 11:06:00 -08:00
Subject: Fwd: SOC 2 re-attestation + retention window for renewal

Folks — forwarding BlueWave's questionnaire and asks. High level: they want to extend audit log retention 12->18 months and need evidence bundled by 11/24. Lauren, can you draft an amendment with a retention option and an estimated monthly delta? Karthik, can you confirm the evidence list + whether we can produce a complete artifact bundle by 11/24? Jonas, can your team handle the bulk transfer and create an access window for their auditors?

Attachments: SOC2_Questionnaire_BlueWave_v2.pdf

Thanks — Soojin

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 3 Nov 2028 09:40:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: SOC 2 re-attestation + retention window for renewal

Soojin / Lauren — reviewed the questionnaire and sketched a plan. Summary below.

Evidence & timing (can deliver by 2028-11-24):
- Control narratives (current) + change log (csv) — export ready.
- Sample CloudTrail / API logs (redacted) covering last 3 months — will generate samples and a snapshot.
- Configuration exports (IAM roles, KMS policies, logging config) — available.
- Retention proof: S3 lifecycle rules and current storage class migration logs.

Retention extension options:
1) 18-month warm retention (S3 Standard → S3 Intelligent-Tiering with archival copy): +$0.015/token-equivalent per 1M tokens/day average (est).
2) 18-month cold archive (S3 Glacier Deep Archive for older segments): +$0.006/token-equivalent per 1M tokens/day average (lower monthly storage but retrieval fees).

Commercial / SLA considerations:
- If we extend retention to 18 months we should add a clause for retrieval SLAs (24–48 hrs for archive).
- For the auditor handoff we'll prepare a signed evidence manifest and a checksum list for transferred artifacts.

Operational ask: Jonas, please prepare a pre-signed transfer URL or SFTP with 7-day access and a manifest layout. Lauren, happy to review the amendment draft for the technical wording.

Karthik
Sr. Security & Compliance Engineer
Redwood Inference

[Attachment: proposed-retention-pricing-worksheet.xlsx]

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
To: Alex Morgan <alex.morgan@bluewavehealth.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Procurement Team <procurement@bluewavehealth.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Nov 2028 16:28:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Assurance re-attestation: retention window & billing adjustment proposal

Hi Alex / team — thanks for the patience. Per internal review here is our proposal: 

1) Amendment: add an optional retention tier to extend audit log retention from 12 to 18 months. We will include retrieval SLAs and a one-line addition to the Data Retention schedule. Draft attached (amendment-draft-BlueWave.pdf).

2) Pricing: we recommend the cold-archive option (Glacier-style) for BlueWave based on your access profile. Estimated delta: $1,150/month (based on current usage you shared). See attached worksheet for calculation.

3) Evidence handoff: Redwood will deliver the evidence bundle via a secure transfer by 2028-11-24. Jonas will send the transfer link within 24 hours of your sign-off. 

4) Credits: given the short notice for re-attestation, we can provide a one-time $4,000 account credit applied to the first invoice post-amendment. This is contingent on signing the amendment by 2028-11-30.

Please review and let us know:
- Do you want the warm vs cold retention? (we recommend cold for predictable costs)
- Confirm procurement timing so we can queue the DocuSign link.

Thanks,
Lauren Bishop
Account Executive, Enterprise
Redwood Inference

[Attachment: amendment-draft-BlueWave.pdf]
